Name: Informant - Stardew Aquarium Add-on
Author: LunaLycan287
Description:
[size=5][u]Informant - Stardew Aquarium Add-On[/u][/size]

This mod adds a new decorator to the Informant mod, which marks fish that have not yet been donated to the Stardew Aquarium with a [img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonwolf287/stardew-aquarium-informant-addon/main/StardewAquariumInformant/assets/aquarium.png[/img]﻿ icon.


[size=4][u]Installation[/u]
[/size]
[list]
[*]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14293]Informant[/url]﻿ mod.
[*]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6372]Stardew Aquarium[/url] mod.

[*]Download the mod.
[*]Unzip the file.
[*]Copy "StardewAquariumInformant" to your mods folder.
[/list]
[size=4][u]Compatibility[/u][/size]

[list]
[*]Can be added / removed with existing saves.

[*]There are no known mod compatibility issues.
[/list]
